minutes.headline: Board rejected an ecological fibers tax break for Town Meeting and held three entertainment licenses over.
minutes.summary: The board heard public comment on the DPW fuel tanks and the proposed assistant town manager position, then received the FY2018 audit, which had a clean opinion, and a Council on Aging update. A motion for a TIF warrant article for ecological fibers failed. The board continued three entertainment license requests amid a zoning enforcement order, created a land acquisition committee, set Town Meeting for Saturday May 4, and voted to include articles 21 to 24 in the draft warrant.

what_happened.line: A motion for a warrant article to authorize negotiating a tax increment financing agreement with ecological fibers failed.
Annual Town Meeting was set for Saturday, May 4, at 9:00 a.m., with no formal second day announced.
The board voted to include articles 21 through 24 in the draft Annual Town Meeting warrant.
Hearings on three entertainment license requests were continued to a future meeting amid a zoning enforcement order; the vote was not audible.
The board received the FY2018 audit, which had a clean opinion, and heard the town manager describe a proposed assistant town manager and HR director position.

why_it_matters: The failed tax break means the ecological fibers exemption will not go to voters as a warrant article, and members said the amounts were small but would set a precedent for later requests.

The Town Meeting date and the draft warrant articles set what residents will be asked to vote on, and the proposed assistant town manager position would be a new staffing cost on the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: The future meeting where the continued entertainment license hearings resume.
Annual Town Meeting on Saturday, May 4, at 9:00 a.m., and the final warrant with articles 21 through 24.
